page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Above the text, centred, the running head "EPISTOLA". No margin notes, no footnotes, no page number, catchword or signature printed.

main_text.l: Illustrissima, debitor factus. Hinc munus,
quod vides. Munus, fateor, perexile, si meam
lucubrationem, tenuiculum; si tuum splen-
dorem, qui non nisi splendida poscit; at ma-
gnum, si animum dantis gratum; at maxi-
mum, si rem ipsam spectabis. His accedit,
quod his ipsis in libris Keckermannum, ma-
gnum illum philosophiae quondam docto-
rem, afferere, & methodum ab illo traditam
observare studui. Hujus viri scripta Anglis
placere inde colligo, quod multa illius scripta
ab illis sint typis descripta. Magnum hoc in-
terpretor beneficium, quo τοῦ μακαρίτου scri-
pta afficitis; & hac εὐσφωνήσει[?] gratias ago, non
meis, sed discipulorum illius verbis, pro tanto,
quo ipsius opera fovetis, favore. Accipe itaq;
Illustrissima Academia, levidense hoc munus;
exiguam hanc opellam ad judicii tui limam
exige; eandem, ubi opus est, de novo refinge;
scuto authoritatis tuae contra Theoninū livo-
ris dentem defende; perexilem istam grati ani-
mi officiiq; mei significationem aequi boni
consule, & juxta mecum statue, hanc benefi-
cii esse naturam, redire ad eum unde venit.
Ad te redeunt,
Mater Illustrissima, quae a te ve-
nerunt ad me beneficia. Ad me autem? Imo
omneis Germaniae nostrae Theologos ortho-
doxos, qui scripta Perkinsi in pretio habent.
Profecto unius Perkinsi τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις[?] causa me-
am istam cuicuimodi est, opellam apud te sym-
bolum animi mei ad praesens depono, & in fu-
turum certissimi obsequii, prout debeo, pi-
gnus,

page.notes: The Greek words τοῦ μακαρίτου, εὐσφωνήσει and τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις are small and tightly set; the accents and final letters are uncertain, so they are marked [?]. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The word "Hujus" is kept with the printed j. The printed tilde over the u in "Theoninū" is rendered as a macron. The final line "gnus," is set right-aligned and continues the hyphenated "pi-" from the line before.
